data.name: S_AutoMiniWindow_D
data.value: Closes the full window and opens the always-on-top mini window once timing passes the configured duration

data.name: S_AutoMiniWindow_Countdown_D
data.value: Shrinks to the mini window once the countdown has been running for the configured duration

data.name: S_AutoMiniWindow_Stopwatch_D
data.value: Shrinks to the mini window once the stopwatch has been running for the configured duration

data.name: S_AutoMiniWindow_Clock_D
data.value: Shrinks to the mini window once the clock has been on screen for the configured duration

data.name: S_AutoMiniWindow_Seconds_D
data.value: How many seconds of timing pass before the mini window opens (for the clock, how long it has been on screen)
